taskDescription: Artifact contract versioning + deterministic output tests
requirements: All prerequisite tasks are marked DONE in the selected execution path: WES-001.
Owning repository has an active branch with contract/codegen artifacts synchronized to current baselines.

userStory.desire: As an Artifact Determinism Engineer, I want versioned contracts and deterministic output tests so generated artifacts are predictable and migration-safe.

motivation.summary: Deterministic artifact governance prevents invisible protocol drift across repositories.
supportsOrUnblocks: Directly supports WES-004 one-pass profile reliability.
Improves confidence in codegen updates consumed by Echo and app repos.

acceptanceCriteria: Generated artifacts include explicit contract version metadata and deterministic build fingerprinting.
Deterministic output tests enforce byte-for-byte stable generation for identical inputs.
Version bump policy is codified for backward-incompatible contract changes.

assertions: Determinism tests compare repeated generation outputs and fail on byte drift.
Version metadata tests verify semver/breaking-change rules are applied consistently.
Artifact diff tests produce focused diagnostics on first divergent section.
goldenPath: Generate artifacts twice from same schema and assert identical hash and file bytes.
Introduce intentional breaking schema change and verify contract version increments.
edgeCases: Whitespace/comment-only source edits do not alter artifact fingerprints.
Non-deterministic map iteration order is normalized in output serialization.
fuzzScale: Run determinism harness across randomized schema graph orders and verify stable emitted artifacts.
failureCases: Version metadata omission fails generation with explicit remediation.
Hash collision/parse failure in fingerprint step fails build before artifact publish.

inScope: Code, tests, and docs directly required to complete WES-003: Artifact contract versioning + deterministic output tests.
Boundary contracts and adapters touched by this task within project ownership.
Task-level observability needed to debug deterministic behavior and integration outcomes.
outOfScope: Unrelated feature work outside dependency chain impact.
Broad redesigns not required to satisfy acceptance criteria for this task.
Cross-repo migration work not explicitly referenced by this task dependencies.

definitionOfDone: All acceptance criteria are satisfied with linked test evidence.
Task metadata is updated to DONE in DAG source for WES-003.
Any architecture exceptions are either removed or documented with owner + expiry.
No workaround-only seams were introduced to complete this task.
